title: Aromatic Crispy Indian Beans Fritters
description: A briny, crispy, double-fried bean fritter that melds North Indian spices with a savory crunch, perfect for a quick pescatarian weeknight meal.

ingredients.name: spice mix
ingredients.notes: cumin, coriander, garam masala, turmeric, chili powder

instructions: Soak the dried white beans overnight in water, then drain and rinse.
Boil the beans in fresh water for 20 minutes until tender, then drain and let cool.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled beans, diced onion, minced garlic, grated ginger, and chopped cilantro; mash lightly with a fork to create a coarse paste.
Add the spice mix, flour mix, baking powder, salt, and black pepper to the bean mixture and stir until a thick batter forms.
Heat 1 cup of oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C); test by dropping a small amount of batter, it should sizzle and rise.
Drop spoonfuls of the batter into the hot oil, spacing them evenly, and fry until golden and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the fritters with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle additional chopped cilantro and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice over the fritters before serving.
Serve hot with a side of mint yogurt dip or tamarind chutney.
